verses.t: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh
verses.yusufAli: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish
verses.rodwell: For the union of the KOREISCH
verses.sale: For the uniting of the tribe of Koreish

verses.t: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer
verses.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer
verses.yusufAli: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer
verses.rodwell: Their union in equipping caravans winter and summer
verses.sale: their uniting in sending forth the caravan of merchants and purveyors in winter and summer

verses.t: Let them worship the Lord of this House
verses.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House
verses.yusufAli: Let them adore the Lord of this House
verses.rodwell: And let them worship the Lord of this house, who hath provided them with food against hunger
verses.sale: Let them serve the Lord of this house

verses.t: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear
verses.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear
verses.yusufAli: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger)
verses.sale: who supplieth them with food against hunger, and hath rendered them secure from fear
